data_integrity_note: Real/public data is distinguished from synthetic data throughout the project. GTFS route/stop/trip data is sourced from public repositories. Individual ticket transactions are synthetically generated in later phases.

sources.name: Vonter/bmtc-gtfs
sources.caveat: Data sourced from Namma BMTC app which may not be completely accurate, particularly for timetables and stop timings. Only routes with functional live tracking are included.
sources.purpose_in_fareguard: Transit network structure (routes, stops, trips, stop_times, shapes)

sources.name: BMTC Aggregate Operational Statistics

primary_sources.publisher: Planning, Programme Monitoring and Statistics Department, Government of Karnataka
primary_sources.period: FY 2023-24 (Full Year & Period up to Nov 2023)

primary_sources.document: BMTC Audited Financial Statements & Annual Report FY 2023-24
primary_sources.publisher: Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC), Government of Karnataka

daily_ridership.source_document: Economic Survey of Karnataka 2024-25 (Transport & Communications Chapter)
daily_ridership.notes: Full year FY 2023-24 average post-Shakti Scheme surge. Interim period up to Nov 2023 recorded 36.27 Lakh/day.

operating_fleet.source_document: Economic Survey of Karnataka 2023-24 (Table: BMTC Operational Statistics)
operating_fleet.notes: Vehicles operated on scheduled routes. Total fleet including maintenance/depot reserve is 6,569.

fleet_utilization_pct.source_document: Economic Survey of Karnataka 2023-24 (Section: Urban Transport Performance)

operating_loss_crore.source_document: BMTC Audited Annual Financial Report FY 2023-24
operating_loss_crore.notes: Operating loss of Rs 575.45 Crore (42.3% reduction from Rs 997.38 Crore in FY 2022-23).

non_traffic_revenue_crore.source_document: BMTC Annual Report FY 2023-24 (Commercial & Non-Fare Revenue Section)
non_traffic_revenue_crore.notes: Generated from land leasing, commercial complexes (TTMC), stalls, and advertisements.

annual_traffic_revenue_crore.source_document: BMTC Performance Review FY 2023-24 (Traffic Revenue Account)
annual_traffic_revenue_crore.notes: Total traffic revenue Rs 1,691.07 Crore (+24.1% year-on-year increase).

avg_daily_traffic_revenue_crore.calculation: Annual Traffic Revenue (Rs 1,691.07 Crore) / 365 Days = Rs 4.633 Crore / Day
avg_daily_traffic_revenue_crore.source_document: Calculated from BMTC FY 2023-24 Traffic Revenue

avg_fare_inr.derivation: Weighted average of ordinary non-AC bus stage fares (Stage 1 @ Rs 5 to Stage 14 @ Rs 30; commuter trip volume concentrated in Stages 3-6 @ Rs 15-20).
avg_fare_inr.source_document: BMTC Public Fare Stage Structure Notification

sources.source_type: Compiled from verified public government documents
sources.caveat: These aggregate figures are derived from official public government publications for FY 2023-24. They provide high-level calibration anchors for the synthetic data generator and do not represent individual electronic ticketing machine (ETM) transaction logs.
sources.purpose_in_fareguard: Statistical calibration of synthetic demand and revenue simulation layers
